notes.title: Women's Day Sale and REPLAY BOYS trading cards
notes.content:
Women's Day Sale
Get ready to rock! I'm happy to let you know REPLAY BOYS is participating in the Women's Day Sale. This surreal adventure was written and directed by the wonderful Bell. I encourage you to peruse the fantastic array of games led by women and gender-marginalized developers.

Trading Cards
If you've already played the game, you might have noticed some little treats in your Steam inventory! Steam trading cards have been released so you can collect all your favourite boys, as well as Hannah and Cronut.
Plus, check out these cute emojis you can get in the points shop: ːrbcronutːːrbhannahːːrbnikoːːrbjaxːːrbtylerːːrbcalebː

Invade your group chat with 1000xCronut today!

notes.title: The History Update
notes.content:
Warm winter greetings, boy band babysitters!

We are happy to announce a new update for REPLAY BOYS with the features you've been asking for, as well as other improvements.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44254809/789468404aafc59213aba3d789098185b8258d04.png

Added a History feature which can be accessed with the Tab key, Mouse Button 4 (the "Back" button on most mice), or X Button on an Xbox controller. From the history view, you can also select any line of the story to replay from that point in time. Please note that if you are continuing from a game saved in the older version, you will only be able view the history that was played in the new update and onwards.
Added a Hide Interface feature which can be accessed with the \ (Backslash) key, Mouse Button 5 (the "Forward" button on most mice), or View Button on an Xbox controller. Now you can find the garden gnome that was hiding at Caleb's house-- and in your heart-- all along.
Fixed a bug which halted progress upon entering the elevator in Chapter 4 if a specific set of choices had been made.
Fixed a bug which could result in skipping part of the story if you refuse to help The Replay Boys in Chapter 3.
Fixed a few cases of flavour text not triggering correctly based on your choices.
A sprinkling of grammatical edits.
Adjusted colour of characters in some locations to better fit with the backgrounds.
Adjusted time of day shown in the background of a couple scenes to be more accurate.
Fixed police siren sound.
Added animation on the menu selection arrows when using keyboard or gamepad input.
Volume sliders can now be dragged with the mouse. (whee!)


What's next?
We're working on support for Mac OS, as well as planning our next game!

notes.title: Update Notes for Oct 27
notes.content:
Hello to all video-editors-turned-band-managers!
Today we have a patch with some requested features and bug fixes.

The "Skip Faster" function has been replaced with "Jump to Choice/Unread". This is handy for replaying the game to see other endings without having to play or skip through parts you've already read. Hold Backspace, Middle Mouse, or Y on Xbox controller to use this feature. There is also a button that appears when jumping is available when using the mouse.
Added a "Text Animation" option in the settings. This can be turned off to display text instantly with no reveal animation.
Increased the number of save slots from 8 to 12.
Fixed a bug where the game would forget which parts you've already read if Steam Cloud was disabled.
Fixed a bug where saving the game, making a choice, then reloading and picking a different choice would still stick to the first choice you made.

Thanks for playing and we hope you are enjoying the game. Let us know what you think!

notes.title: Controller support? We've got you covered!
notes.content:
Like to play from the couch? REPLAY BOYS plays great with a controller!

We've tested to make sure all the popular controllers work properly.
- Mouse
- Keyboard
- XBox 360/One/Series Controllers
- Other XInput Controllers
- PlayStation 4/5 Controllers*
- Switch Pro Controller*
- Steam Controller*
- Generic Gamepads*
*Make sure you have Steam Input enabled!

You can remap the controllers using Steam Input for your convenience.

And Steam Deck? Yes! We've tested the game on Steam Deck and it runs perfectly.

REPLAY BOYS is releasing on October 25th, see you soon!
